claims: C1 developer instructions carry developer-level authority
C2 obeying a developer instruction is obligatory
C3 the obligation is lifted when the instruction is overridden by a root or system instruction

concepts.name: developer_instruction
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction given by a developer using the OpenAI API, carrying developer-level authority

concepts.name: overridden_by_root_or_system
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction that is overridden by a root or system instruction, so the developer instruction no longer prevails

concepts.name: authority_levels_hierarchy
concepts.gloss: the ranking of instruction authority levels: root > system > developer > user > guideline > no authority, used to determine which instruction prevails in conflicts

concepts.name: developer_authority
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction given by a developer using the OpenAI API, carrying developer-level authority

asserts.read_back: obeying developer instruction % is obligatory unless it is overridden by a root or system instruction

closure.reason: the clause obliges obedience to developer instructions and lifts that obligation only when overridden by root or system instructions; it says nothing about other acts, so silence permits them
